_readme: Reported outlet (store) counts INSIDE CHINA (and total/overseas where split) for the chains we track — a Pro-tier intelligence dimension (home-market scale vs US footprint). Sourced from PRIMARY filings (HKEX/SEC/cninfo, confidence 'high', with China/overseas splits) or company statements / reputable press (confidence 'medium', often a worldwide total). Every entry carries as_of + source. NOT public — Pro only; never written to map/data. Refresh the 'high' rows when the filings collector flags a new annual report; curate the 'medium' rows from company/press.

nayuki.note: 1,288 self-op + 358 franchise; China-focused, overseas not split out

chabaidao.note: overseas: 18 South Korea, 5 Malaysia, 3 Singapore, 3 Thailand, 2 Australia, 1 Hong Kong, 2 Macau, 2 France, 1 Spain, 1 United States — supersedes the FY2024 china:8395/overseas:14/total:8409 row

aunteajenny.source: press coverage of Auntea Jenny FY2025 results announcement (HKEX:2589, ~Mar 2026); not independently verified against the primary PDF this run
aunteajenny.note: 26 direct + 11,423 franchise; +24.8% vs 9,176 at end-2024; 45 overseas stores opened during 2025 (US/South Korea/Malaysia) — supersedes the FY2024 overseas:1/total:9176 row

taier.note: Tai Er brand; Jiumaojiu group 644 restaurants

semir.source: press (36Kr/TMTPost) citing Semir FY2025 annual report (SZSE:002563); not independently verified against primary filing text this run
semir.note: Balabala ~5,255 + Semir adult ~2,676 brand-level; may exclude concession counters in the prior FY2024 total (8,325, incl 85 concession + 100+ HK/overseas) — not directly comparable; supersedes that row pending primary verification

bestore.source: brokerage research note (Everbright Securities) citing Bestore FY2025 annual report (SSE:603719); not independently verified against primary filing text this run
bestore.note: -597 net vs 2024 (248 franchise + 349 direct closures); net loss RMB -147.65M is primary-confirmed; this store figure is secondary — supersedes the FY2024 china:2704 row pending primary verification

mglife.source: Beijing Business Today (北京商报) citing M&G/Chenguang FY2025 annual report (SSE:603899); not independently verified against primary filing text this run
mglife.note: Mu Wu (九木杂物社) only, up from 741 at FY2024 (晨光生活馆 sub-count not found this run) — supersedes the FY2024 china:741 row pending primary verification

juewei.source: chairman Dai Wenjun, FY2025/Q1-2026 earnings call, 10 Jun 2026 (Jiemian/Beijing News)
juewei.note: CORRECTION: approximate FLOOR only — chairman said 'just over 10,000' (逾万家) at year-end 2025; company has not disclosed a precise store count since FY2023. SUPERSEDES the prior total:16000 figure, which looks stale/overstated (that followed the company's first annual loss since its 2017 IPO). Do NOT backfill with third-party monitoring-platform figures.

luckycup.note: Mixue's coffee arm; ~10,000, almost all China

bosideng.source: Bosideng International Holdings FY2025/26 annual results (HKEX:3998, 25 Jun 2026)
bosideng.note: Regular retail stores, down apparel business only (35.0% self-op / 65.0% distributor-op); excludes 1,000+ peak-season stores established during the year; no separate overseas count disclosed (overseas is mostly wholesale, per register.json)

maogeping.note: 412 self-operated + 33 distributor-operated counters, 131 PRC cities; +1 first Hong Kong counter (Harbour City, opened ~Oct 2025)

lining.source: Li Ning Company Limited 2025 Annual Results announcement (HKEX:2331, ~19 Mar 2026)
lining.note: LI-NING brand (Core Brand + YOUNG) points of sale; net +24 vs year-end 2024; no separate China/overseas split (US store closed, no open overseas retail yet per register.json)

toys52.source: 澎湃新闻 (The Paper), '国内只剩5家店，52TOYS，想上市', 26 May 2025
toys52.note: OWN-BRAND retail stores in China only (~5, per press, around its May 2025 HKEX A1 filing). 52TOYS (北京乐自天成) is an IP/blind-box maker selling mainly via wholesale, e-commerce and third-party retail — its own-store count badly UNDERSTATES scale and is not a retail-chain footprint. 16 months stale; the IPO prospectus has the precise figure. See listings.json toys52 (ipo_pending).
